selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Near-zero capped LES real-space latent-charge tail; lowest-risk direct test of GEN023-M01 while preserving proposal_006 fallback and fixed benchmark semantics.
Ultra-conservative beta probe; provides a second small-step exploit to distinguish real LES-tail signal from neutral variance without introducing PBC/Ewald/cell assumptions.
Stronger LES tail with wider sigma and higher beta cap; probes whether ISO17 energy/gap can benefit from a more visible all-pair latent-charge interaction while remaining bounded.
Two-sigma LES electrostatic tail; tests multi-scale nonperiodic real-space kernels derived from GEN023-M01 and the CACE realspace trace without changing dataset or launch protocol.
Mechanism ablation disabling the source cutoff charge shell to isolate the all-pair LES tail from ordinary source-shell or residual calibration effects.
Exact source replicate variance control for generation_022/proposal_006; required because generation_022 deltas were small and proposal_006 did not beat the parent/control by a robust margin.
RMS-normalized latent charges before LES tail; keeps the same GEN023-M01 kernel but controls charge scale so the tail can act without destabilizing RMD17 forces.
Smooth outer-domain LES tail beyond the source cutoff; complements proposal_005 by focusing the new mechanism specifically where cutoff-local charge shells cannot act.

selection_policy: Select eight units that best test the A-grade LES evidence package around mechanism GEN023-M01-les-realspace-latent-charge-tail while preserving benchmark semantics and attribution discipline. The set includes two conservative small-beta exploits, bounded stronger/multiscale/outer-domain LES variants, a charge-scale exploit, an exact source replicate, and a mechanism ablation that separates the all-pair LES tail from the existing cutoff charge shell. Defer learned-sigma and training-objective variants because the first adds parameterization risk and the second confounds mechanism attribution with loss calibration under the fixed benchmark protocol.

Stronger bounded LES tail with sigma=1.5 and beta cap 0.004
LES all-pair tail vs source cutoff charge-shell ablation
Exact generation_022/proposal_006 source replicate variance control
RMS-normalized latent charges before LES tail
Smooth outer-domain LES tail beyond cutoff

les_evidence_constraints.benchmark_semantics: No dataset, metric, launch protocol, PBC/Ewald/cell, or charge-label changes; use nonperiodic real-space LES tail only.

omitted_proposals.reason: Bounded learned-sigma LES tail is interesting but adds an additional learned scale/identifiability risk; fixed-sigma and two-sigma selected variants provide cleaner mechanism attribution first.

Energy-balanced training objective control may be useful later, but it confounds LES mechanism attribution with loss calibration; selected proposal_005 plus exact replicate give cleaner controls under an 8-unit implementation budget.
